title: Tanklet: Idle Fish Aquarium
summary: Tanklet is a cozy aquarium game where you raise a tank of fish that's truly yours. Feed them, clean the tank, keep the water healthy, and watch them drift through a beautifully rendered aquarium — all the joy and companionship of fishkeeping, none of the cost or mess. ■ Care for your fish Feed on schedule, clean the tank, and manage water quality. Well-cared-for fish stay healthy, happy, and earn more coins. Neglect them and they get listless or sick — but good care always brings them back. Your fish never die. ■ Rare visitors Wild fish drop by from time to time. Feed them, keep the water clean, and set out the decorations they love — treat them well and they may stay for good. The rarer the visitor, the pickier they are. ■ Personalities & bonds Every fish has its own personality. Greet them daily and serve their favorite treats to deepen your bond, unlocking little stories and rewards. ■ Collect & breed From clownfish, blue tang and angelfish to golden arowana and koi, collect distinctive species and fill your codex. Breed pairs for offspring, with a chance at rare variants and shiny fish. ■ Eggs with honest odds Hatch mystery eggs for new species — drop rates are disclosed before every purchase, with a pity system that guarantees rare finds. ■ Send fish on treasure hunts Pick 1–2 fish for expeditions to the reef, a shipwreck, or the deep abyss. Hours later they return with coins, decorations — sometimes even pearls. Strong bonds and healthy fish bring better luck. ■ Make the tank yours Buy and freely place plants, driftwood, rocks and more. Resize, restyle, and decorate your tank exactly how you like it. ■ More tanks, real ecosystems Save up for a second and third tank: freshwater, saltwater and coral ecosystems each boost matching fish. Every tank has its own theme and decorations, and fish can move anytime. ■ Ambient Mode: put your tank in a room Hide the interface and let your tank live in a warm little room. Nine rooms to swap — an indigo moon window, a brick loft, a green library, a coastal cottage… each room's light truly falls into the water. Keep the screen on and it becomes living furniture. ■ Grows while you're away Close the app and your fish keep you company while coins keep accruing. Come back to collect offline earnings and see what happened. ■ Calm, anywhere A Home Screen widget brings your tank to your desktop; soft water-sound ambience helps you unwind; iCloud keeps your tank in sync across devices. No ads, no third-party SDKs, zero data collection — your tank is yours alone. Subscribe to Tanklet+ for double coins, offline earnings extended 8→24 hours, auto-care while away, a monthly pearl gift, and exclusive decor. Slow down. Keep some fish.

title: Eid & Asche: Oath & Ash
summary: Oath & Ash (Eid & Asche) is a turn-based fantasy card game with detailed art, animated hero portraits and punchy battle sound. It is fully playable with VoiceOver. Every card, every enemy move and every result is announced, and nothing is ever timed. THREE HEROES, THREE WAYS TO PLAY The Knight holds the line with armor, guard and counterattacks. The Hunter sets traps, spreads poison and outlasts the enemy. The Mage controls the flow of cards with chains and frost. The Hunter unlocks after Act I, the Mage after Act II. Each hero has their own cards, deck and progress. THREE ACTS Walk the Thorn Path, cross the Ashlands and brave the Sand Sea. Each act has ten encounters, its own enemies and boss fights. Enemies show their next move before they make it, so you can plan ahead. Losing costs you no progress. Change your deck and try again. COLLECT AND UPGRADE Win cards in battle or open card boxes with three random cards. The app shows the odds for each rarity before you open a box. Salvage duplicates for Dust and use it to upgrade your favorite cards. Your deck is yours to build. SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY Check the Daily tab for a new challenge each day, with its own rules and rewards. EXPEDITIONS Set out with a small deck and build it as you go. Three legs, each a map with branching paths to fights, rests, merchants and events, and a boss at the end. Relics give you lasting advantages, and your health carries over from fight to fight. In the weekly Expedition everyone plays the same map, and the top places in the ranking win weekly prizes. THE SEASON PATH Wins, duels and daily battles earn you embers to climb the Season Path: 40 levels of Dust, Diamonds, card boxes, titles, card backs, frames, avatars and victory lines. New looks arrive every month. The Path Letter opens a second track with more rewards. THE ARENA Duel the saved defense decks of real players. You play your turns, the game plays theirs. There is no turn timer, and every deck fights with its real card levels, so deckbuilding and tactics decide. If no player is a good match, a clearly labeled Arena Guardian steps in for half points. Climb from Starter through Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum to Diamond. Each season lasts one month, and the ranking shows your display name and avatar. Challenge friends to friendly duels with an invite link, and every profile shows league, heroes and collection. BUILT FOR VOICEOVER • Every value, card text and enemy intent is spoken • No time pressure, in the acts or in the Arena • Battle log with one heading per round for quick navigation • Narrator Helmut guides you in English and German • Every enemy has a voice of its own, and every boss its own music and entrance • You can hear when it's your turn, how hard a hit landed and when your health runs low • Settings, Learn the sounds lets you hear every sound and what it means • Support for larger text, reduced motion and haptic feedback GOOD TO KNOW Your progress is saved to your iCloud account, so you need to be signed in to iCloud on your device. Battles, Expeditions and the Arena need an internet connection. Your collection and the tutorial also work offline. Diamonds and the Path Letter are optional in-app purchases. There are no ads. Questions or problems? Reach us at support.kroegoor.com.

title: Upward: Number Merge Puzzle
summary: Drop a number. Set off a chain. Climb to Orbit. Only the bottom rungs ever fall. Drop a number into one of five columns, watch equal numbers double where they touch, and let gravity chain one merge into the next — climbing 2 Pebble all the way to 512 Orbit. NO ADS. NO LIVES. NO BOOSTS. No ads, no consumable lives to wait out, and nothing you can buy to raise a score. Pro is a one-time unlock or a Play Pass — or nothing at all. PLAN THE CLIMB See the piece in hand and the next two pieces before you commit. Choose a column, set up connected matches, and build chain reactions that can transform the whole board. ONE SHARED DAILY Every player starts with the same Daily seed and 50-drop rules. Later pieces respond to your climb, so planning the ladder matters. 16 FIXED CHALLENGES Learn Upward through four chapters of authored, repeatable boards. The four-stage Trailhead chapter is free. Pro opens Ridgecraft, Thin Air, and Orbit School, with XP and board-theme rewards along the way. FIVE WAYS TO PLAY • Daily Climb — the shared 50-drop board • Classic — an open climb to Orbit • Blitz — two minutes, no take-backs • Chain Hunt — 50 drops with bonus points for deep cascades • Rising Sky — safe board space contracts every 10 drops BUILT TO FEEL GOOD Number-first tiles stay readable across every theme. Landing feedback, escalating haptics, rising chain tones, danger states, and a full Orbit celebration make every important move clear. WHAT FREE INCLUDES Free players receive the full Daily Climb, the Daily and Classic leaderboards, three Classic starts per day, the four-stage Trailhead, missions, achievements, and recent local progress. Upward Pro adds unlimited Classic, three specialty modes, 12 advanced challenges, 500-run history, two years of Daily archives, the Blitz leaderboard, friend challenges, Daily history sync, and two more board themes. Choose a one-time Upward Full Game Unlock, or StackForge Play Pass (monthly or annual) — Pro in every StackForge game plus One Good Thing. Prices and renewal terms appear before purchase. title: Sortalis
summary: Sortalis is a dice-building roguelike inspired by Farkle. Roll, score, and decide how far you’re willing to push your luck—then spend your winnings on Charms and upgrades that transform your dice, strengthen your strategy, and rewrite the rules. Every run becomes a new engine to build, exploit, and inevitably push a little too far. **What’s in the game?** • Endless challenges that grow tougher and demand new strategies • Over 150 upgrades to discover and combine into powerful builds • Rewards, unlocks, achievements, Dice Bags, and challenges to master • Multiplayer draft mode! **Roll, Set, or Bank** Roll and select scoring combos carefully. Roll again to make it bigger—or Farkle and lose the lot. Bank before your luck runs out. **Spend It in The Shop** Between Bouts, spend your winnings on Charms, Packs, Action Cards, and other upgrades. Don’t like what’s on the shelf? Redraw it and hunt for the piece your build needs. **Face The House** Every night ends with a boss that changes the rules. THE MISER, for example, won’t let you Bank until your Pot reaches 500. **Then Do It All Again** Every Bank and Farkle adds to your final score. Unlock 14 Dice Bags, tabletops, discover new combinations, and see how far you can push your next run.

title: Decant: Color Sort Puzzle
summary: Pour a little color. Make a little order. Decant is a color-sort puzzle with luminous glass vessels and a simple goal: leave each filled vessel with just one color. Tap a vessel, choose a matching color or an empty space, and pour the top group. Two spare vessels give you room to think—not a shortcut to buy. NO ADS. ROOM TO PLAY. - 180 puzzles across four difficulty levels, each checked for a solution. - A fresh, always-free Daily, with the same ranked board and rules for everyone. - Practice puzzles generated and checked before you play. - Satisfying glass pours—or instant pours when you prefer to skip the animation. - Liquid symbols, a high-contrast palette, and sound, haptic, handedness, and motion controls. - Free restarts. No lives, energy, timers, or extra vessels for sale. Find a solution, then try to make it cleaner. A Perfect clear uses the fewest possible pours. Older archived Daily puzzles may show a Target instead; that is a reference solution, not a promise of the minimum. START FREE. UNLOCK MORE IF YOU LIKE. The first 30 puzzles, today's Daily, and three practice puzzles per day are free, with three undos per board. The Daily does not count against your practice allowance. A one-time Decant Full Game Unlock opens all 180 puzzles, unlimited practice and undos outside the ranked Daily, the full Daily archive for unranked practice, and advanced records. Or choose the StackForge Play Pass for Pro access across StackForge games and One Good Thing. Prices are shown before purchase. Play Pass subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Today's ranked Daily gives every player the same three undos, whether free or Pro. No ads in either tier. Optional account sync keeps your progress and Play Pass connected. title: Tindrift: Merge Roguelike
summary: One slide moves your whole army. Tindrift is a tactics roguelike built on slide-merge combat: same-class, same-rank soldiers merge into a higher rank, and every shadow acts by rule — no dice, ever. 100 floors across five acts, plus an Endless Drift, a Daily Seed and 1v1 duels. The campaign plays offline. NO LUCK TO BLAME Shadows telegraph the move they are about to make, gates cycle on a visible clock, and pits sit where you can plan around them. When a run ends you can name the exact slide that ended it — and when you win, you out-thought the board. YOU COMMAND AN ARMY, NOT A HERO Six soldier classes — vanguard, tank, medic, marksman, poisoner, support — merge only with their own kind, so every squad trades coverage against raw power. Set the formation before you climb: tank into the crowd, marksman down the long lane, medic in the middle. WHAT IS IN THE GAME • A 5-act campaign across 100 floors — 20 per act, with 3 mini-boss fights and one signature boss in each • The Sunken Tray, The Rusthold, The Shivering Span, The Frostlight, The Surface: five acts, one climb, ending in daylight • 46 synergy blueprints (15 common, 23 uncommon, 8 rare) — pierce a lane, detonate poison chains, strip terrain for scrap, or take a drawback for reach • 24 shadow archetypes, 5 mini-bosses and 5 act bosses among them, each with a rule you have to read before you can answer it • 8 terrain types — sealed exits, timed gates, pits, fog and mazes: the map fights back • 7 kinds of tactic across 8 placeable tools, plus a TINKER STATION between floors to heal, promote, recruit and re-arm • An 18-node cog tree worth 2,335 cog — side-grades and finishes, never raw stats • 22 achievements and 3 daily quests drawn from 7 types • Endless Drift, and a Daily Seed with streaks and a result you can share • 1v1 duels, same seed and separate boards: three bot difficulties offline, or trade a 6-character code with a friend, send sabotage between floors and replay their round • Four languages: English, Turkish, German and Spanish • VoiceOver reads the board and re-announces it after every slide, and hazards are named instead of signalled by colour alone VARIETY UNLOCKS, POWER DOES NOT Nothing here is pay-to-win. Loadouts, tactics and blueprints stay behind cog for every player, and the limits per run are the same for everyone: one continue, two rerolls, three undos. ADS, PLAINLY Rewarded videos are always your choice — five spots, all opt-in. Full-screen breaks land on floor transitions and after a run, at most one every two minutes, never mid-move and never on the way into a boss or mini-boss floor. Duels carry none. TINDRIFT PREMIUM — one purchase, no subscription • Removes every ad • Lets you HOST duel rooms (joining a room is always free) • Unlocks the 10 cosmetics the workshop sells: 8 soldier finishes and 2 tray themes Slide. Merge. Climb.

title: Astonischika
summary: Astonischika is a turn-based pixel role-playing game with a roguelite loop. Build a party from bold classes, climb a branching map and fight turn by turn against monsters, elites and bosses. Every run is different: you choose your path across battles, rest sites, treasure, merchants and minigames. When your party falls, the city remains your permanent home — your heroes, their gold and their gear grow from run to run. FEATURES • Build your party from a range of classes — warrior, mage, cleric, rogue, archer and more • Turn-based battles with skills, spells, elements and status effects • Branching map: battle, elite, boss, rest, treasure and merchant • Level-ups, attribute points, equipment and learnable spells • Minigames: shell game, dice, memory, coin flip and more • A permanent city hub — your progress stays after every run • Endless scaling for long-term motivation • 22 languages, music and sound effects GREAT FOR Quick battle rounds in between, or long dungeon sessions.
